value.rationale: The positive/negative range allocation is a natural structural observable of a self-interacting nearest-neighbour walk. Its full exact finite distribution resolves an otherwise unspecified geometric split, and the sign-conditioned law and nonexchangeability show why a Pólya-count marginal does not imply a Pólya process. This identifies order-one range imbalance and explains reinforcement dependence of that imbalance.
